Choose Gen3 for everyday upgrades, Gen4 for gaming and content creation, or Gen5 for demanding workloads on compatible PCs. Select a heatsink model where space allows, or use your device’s cooling solution. Match the SSD size to your device: S91 (M.2 2230) for the original ROG Ally; S93 (M.2 2280) matches the ROG Ally X form factor. Check device requirements before installation. * Performance figures are based on addlink internal testing using specific hardware and configurations. Actual speed may vary by host system, workload, SSD capacity, operating system, and firmware. * PCIe Gen5 SSDs such as G55H require a compatible platform with PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot to reach full performance. * PS5 compatibility refers to meeting Sony’s published M.2 SSD requirements; always check the latest PS5 firmware and guidelines. * ROG Ally (original model) uses M.2 2230 NVMe SSDs, matching the addlink S91 form factor. ROG Ally X uses M.2 2280 NVMe SSDs, matching the addlink S93 form factor; no size adapter is required for this pairing. Installing the shorter S91 in a ROG Ally X would require a suitable 2230-to-2280 mounting adapter, with fit and compatibility verified separately. Always check your exact device model and follow ASUS installation guidelines. Frequently Asked Questions Q1: What is the difference between Gen3, Gen4 and Gen5 NVMe SSDs? Gen3 suits everyday upgrades, Gen4 suits gaming and content creation, and Gen5 suits demanding workloads on compatible PCs. In the addlink lineup, Gen3 models reach up to 3,500MB/s, Gen4 models up to 7,400MB/s and Gen5 models up to 10,300MB/s in sequential read. ​ Q4: What do I need to reach full PCIe Gen5 speed? PCIe Gen5 SSDs such as the G55H require a compatible platform with a PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot to reach full performance. ​ Q2: Which SSDs on this page offer the highest speed and capacity? G55H and G55 offer the highest sequential read speeds on this page, up to 10,300 MB/s. A95 and S95 offer capacities up to 8TB. Actual performance varies by system, capacity and workload. ​ ​ Q5: Are addlink M.2 NVMe SSDs compatible with PS5? The with-heatsink models on this page are listed as PS5-compatible. PS5 compatibility refers to meeting Sony's published M.2 SSD requirements, so always check the latest PS5 firmware and guidelines before installing. Q3: Which addlink SSD fits the ROG Ally and ROG Ally X? The original ROG Ally uses M.2 2230 SSDs, matching the S91 form factor. ROG Ally X uses M.2 2280 SSDs, matching the S93 form factor. Installing an S91 in ROG Ally X requires a suitable 2230-to-2280 mounting adapter, with fit and compatibility verified separately. Follow ASUS installation guidelines. Q6: Do I need an SSD with a heatsink? Choose a heatsink model where there is space, or rely on your device's own cooling solution. addlink offers four NVMe SSDs with a heatsink (G55H, A95, A93 and A85) and ten without (G55, S95, S93, S85, S90 Lite, S88, S83, S70 Lite, S68 and S91). ​ bottom of page
